purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance billing (receipt/shinsa) system - automatic calculation of examination/consultation fees (shinsatsu-ryo) for outpatient medical visits under JMA ORCA system
purpose.summary: This program is part of the JMA ORCA standard medical receipt software system. It handles automatic generation and editing of medical examination fee calculations (shinsatsu-ryo jido hassei henshi shori) for outpatient visits. It processes patient visit data, determines first-visit vs. re-visit fees, applies age-based and time-based rules, and handles various special cases including elderly patients, telephone re-consultations, and same-day re-visits.

notable_features: Large inline lookup table (TBL-SINSATU-AREA) with medical fee codes
LINE SEQUENTIAL file organization for parameter file
31 COPY statements indicating heavy use of shared copybooks
201 PERFORM statements indicating structured procedural logic
Japanese EUC-JP encoded comments (decoded as latin-1 garbled)
No COMP-3 packed decimal despite financial calculations
File path /var/tmp/ indicating Linux/Unix runtime environment
verdict.notes: Source file is encoded in EUC-JP (Japanese encoding) but was decoded as latin-1, causing comment text to appear as garbled characters. The program name ORCSC10S200204 follows JMA ORCA naming conventions. The file is large (4761 lines, ~203KB) and highly structured with extensive revision history comments. The '200204' suffix likely indicates a version or date (2002/04). Only the first 16000 chars were shown but mechanical indicators confirm full COBOL structure with all four divisions present.
